newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK March exports up 5.3 pct, re-exports up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK March exports up 5.3 pct, re-exports up 12 pct.

text.p: The volume of Hong Kong's domestic exports in March increased by 5.3 percent year-on-year, while re-exports rose 12.0 percent, the Census and Statistics Department said on Friday.
Total export volume rose 11.0 percent and import volume grew by 8.3 percent. It said in a statment.

The volume of domestic exports for the first three months of 1997 decreased by 3.9 percent while volume of re-exports leapt 5.5 percent. Total exports rose 4.0 percent and imports grew by 6.4 percent.
Prices of domestic exports were down 2.0 percent in March from a year earlier and re-export prices decreased by 1.2 percent. Import prices also decreased by 2.7 percent.
Prices of domestic exports for the first three months of 1997 were 1.9 percent lower, while those of re-exports fell 1.3 percent and import prices also fell 2.5 percent.

The department said prices are based on unit values which do not take into account changes in the composition or quality of goods traded, except for some selected commodities for which specific price indices are available.
